title: Photo Release Checklist
subtitle: Capture capture type, event setting, audience, and channel; confirm attribution and withdrawal route.
description: Photo Release records capture type, event setting, audience, channel, attribution, and withdrawal route. Photo Release evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this photo release stage-gated verification when staff must document capture type and event setting. Reconcile audience, channel, attribution, and withdrawal route before the photo release handoff. Use the capture plan, shot list, subject or roster match, approved channel list, production exclusion list, published-asset reference, and withdrawal request log. Ask the assigned photo release reviewer to confirm capture type against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Photo Release starting details
sections.guidance: Separate still image, video, audio, name use, event setting, audience, channel, editing, attribution, duration, declined uses, and withdrawal route. Record the photo release decision separately from attendance, registration, or routine operations.

sections.title: Photo Release checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current photo release facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Photo Release required checks
items: Capture type is identified for this record
Event setting matches the current request or source
Audience is ready for point-of-use staff
Channel limits or questions are resolved
Attribution is communicated to the responsible person
Withdrawal route is confirmed at handoff
A changed photo release fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Photo Release failed or pending items

sections.title: Photo Release exception review and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold photo release readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Photo Release reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Photo Release receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
